items.title: Oracle E-Business Suite RCE Vulnerability Exposes Sensitive Data to Hackers Without Authentication
items.description: Oracle has disclosed a critical vulnerability in its E-Business Suite that enables unauthenticated attackers to remotely access sensitive data, raising alarms for enterprises relying on the platform for core operations. Tracked as CVE-2025-61884, the flaw affects the Oracle Configurator component and was detailed in a security alert released on October 11, 2025. This comes just […] The post…
